ov: مكان اسمه الوطن (الإنجليزية: Makan esmoh alwatan) هو فيلم وثائقي تم إنتاجه في مصر وصدر في سنة 2006.
plotEn: Four young Egyptians take different paths to find the place they can each call "home". Due to economic, religious or educational reasons, they are faced with difficulties that will force them to look for a way out through emigration or trying to live with the people that surround them.
